about_the_game:
Grandma Studios, the studio that took you on an adventure on the high seas with Whispered Secrets: Cruise of Misfortune proudly presents a mysterious journey into unknown with, Whispered Secrets: In the Cards!

You’re called to a peaceful village to investigate the disappearance of a well-liked twin sister, only to quickly discover that things here may not be what they seem. This is only the most recent of a handful of similar disappearances, with few clues to follow. These unfortunate victims simply vanished without a trace. The thing about looking for trouble is that trouble tends to find you first, and you’ll soon be fighting your own mind-bending battle to save yourself and your sanity. Follow the evidence carefully and watch your step, or you might find yourself In the Cards!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

  • Does a villain get redemption in the Bonus Game?

  • Unlock an added Bonus Feature with collectibles and morphing objects!

  • Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, music, videos, and more!

  • Check out a collection of downloadable wallpapers, a music player, concept art, and more!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.
